# Confluence Operations Skill
**Use-when:** Reading a User Story from Confluence or publishing Architecture, QA Test Plan, Deployment Guide, or Release Notes pages.
- Execute `node confluencePublisher.js` using credentials in `.env`.
- Always require human `Approved` confirmation before publishing.
